newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 248.596 bln yuan debt in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to issue 248.596 bln yuan debt in 1997.

text.p: China's target for domestic and overseas debt in 1997 is 248.596 billion yuan ($29.95 billion), up 27.3 percent from 1996, Chinese sources said on Friday, quoting Finance Minister Liu Zhongli's budget.
Liu plans to tell the National People's Congress, or parliament, on Sunday that 57 billion yuan will be issued to cover 1997's budget deficit.
Another 195.908 billion yuan will be needed to service domestic and foreign debt, he is expected to say.
That gives a total of 252.908 billion yuan, he said. But total debt to be issued will be 248.596 billion yuan after accounting for a debt income balance of 4.312 billion yuan, he is expected to say.
In 1996, China issued 195.257 billion yuan in debt, a 27-percent jump from the previous year.
